source_build_policy.default: Copy four exact actual generated metadata artifacts after SHA verification; never import them. Their original backend/provenance and optional rebuild driver are preserved.
source_build_policy.optional_rebuild: Use original pristine fixed/base Git commit before test overlay; exact frozen tags/backend tools, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and driver refusing SUT import/exec; require exact resulting metadata SHA. Fail on mismatches; never invent a replacement version.

preparation_algorithm: Verify spec and all packaged inventory/license/generated-artifact SHA digests from a trusted released commit.
Create a new private destination outside all Git trees; refuse existing output/symlink escapes.

Fetch only fixed official codeload source archives and files.pythonhosted.org wheel URLs over verified TLS, bounded by exact declared bytes and SHA256. Never execute dataset commands or source setup scripts.
Safely read ordinary tar files under one root; refuse nonregular members, duplicates, traversal, excess expansion, mismatching complete file sets or SHA/size. Keep full original source inventories.
base_tests = original base production with exact fixed changed test/fixture overlays; fixed_tests = exact fixed source. Add only the four reviewed declared generated version artifacts.
Require resulting entire physical role inventories to match published path/hash/bytes pins exactly. No assertion editing or selected-task replacement.

Create a separate venv using CPython3.12.2 reference runtime; install only exact reviewed wheels offline with full hash locks, bootstrap pip24.0 included; pip check. No SUT package installation, production imports, target collection or tests.

Write a new private runner manifest with absolute paths resolved only inside private output, fixed whole-module test_files, exact dependency_versions, explicit pytest_mock.plugin or empty list, fixed error warning filter or empty list, and fresh runtime provenance. Preparation success is not test success.

exposure_limits.meaning: Unseen only relative to this recorded research exposure inventory. No model-pretraining contamination claim. No claim of representative or confirmatory population; eight convenience-selected bug fixes.

upstream_PR_metadata_query.endpoint: GitHub official search/issues and pulls/{number}, pulls/{number}/files; no comments or messages posted
upstream_PR_metadata_query.sort: created descending, numeric PR descending tie break
upstream_PR_metadata_query.stable_source_versions: merge_commit_sha fix, its first parent base; PR head and merge metadata retained; exact base/fix full official archives
upstream_PR_metadata_query.candidate_records: Every examined candidate retained with metadata and exact eligibility reason, including rejected and retrieval/preparation failures.

repository_eligibility: Absent from conservative recorded exposure repository set.
Official Python library with actual permissive license bytes; CPU/offline pytest path under current CPython3.12 or supported installed3.11/3.10; no GPU/service/commercial/model dependency.
Source/test archives each <=30MiB compressed and selected expanded repository <=100MiB; no unknown install script execution.
task_eligibility_before_freeze: Merged PR metadata title identifies bug fix, not feature/docs-only/refactor/dependency bump.
Both real production Python and original Python tests change between first-parent base and fixed merge; modified file count<=25 and additions+deletions<=800.
At least one original added/modified pytest test function with assertion or pytest.raises covers changed behavior; tests can be selected by exact unchanged function IDs and original file bytes.
Static imports and fixtures indicate small CPU/offline operation using stdlib or ordinary legally obtainable wheels; tmp filesystem or deterministic simulated platform inputs allowed.
No target execution, no candidate graph/retrieval/model scoring during eligibility or selection.
selection_rule.selection_algorithm: For each nonexcluded eligible repository in priority order, retain the first two eligible merged PRs in official created-descending search order. Freeze all eight identities and original test selection before any target run. Continue candidate review only for static eligibility failures; do not replace a frozen task after preparation/execution failure. If fewer than four repositories/two eligible tasks within caps, record shortage and request protocol amendment rather than inventing or outcome-selecting cases.
selection_rule.whole_test_scope: Run complete original fixed changed Python test modules, including original parametrization and all tests. No invented F2P/P2P labels; compare real original assertion outcomes between base production+same fixed tests and fixed source+same tests. Metadata target function labels may be recorded for reading, never used to shrink execution denominator. Keep conftest/fixtures and relevant options exact; static transplant ambiguity fails eligibility before selection.
selection_rule.prospective_amendment: Before selecting any task and before target/method execution, added four candidates because five of initial eight were exposure-excluded; original order retained. Whole changed test modules replace invented F2P/P2P labels. Original rule and amendment records preserved.
